items.title: Short ramp-up glofitamab halves mortality after anti-CD19 CAR T-cell failure in DLBCL (LYSA BiCAR phase 2)
items.abstract: Final results of the phase 2 LYSA BiCAR trial with a pre-specified external control arm: a short ramp-up of the CD20xCD3 bispecific glofitamab halved mortality risk in diffuse large B-cell lymphoma that had failed anti-CD19 CAR T-cell therapy, a setting with no established standard of care.

items.title: EBMT recommendations on autologous and allogeneic transplantation in adult Hodgkin lymphoma
items.abstract: Updated EBMT Practice Harmonisation and Guidelines Committee and Lymphoma Working Party recommendations on autologous and allogeneic hematopoietic cell transplantation for adult Hodgkin lymphoma, developed by 23 experts across transplant, lymphoma and radiation oncology.

items.title: Favorable tolerability of asciminib versus ATP-competitive TKIs in newly diagnosed chronic-phase CML (ASC4FIRST)
items.abstract: Analysis from the ASC4FIRST study showing favorable tolerability of the STAMP inhibitor asciminib versus ATP-competitive tyrosine kinase inhibitors in newly diagnosed chronic-phase chronic myeloid leukemia, where persistent adverse events often impair daily living.

items.title: PD-L2 is associated with transcriptional programs distinct from PD-L1 in primary mediastinal large B-cell lymphoma
items.abstract: Translational study showing PD-L2 is associated with lineage-related transcriptional programs distinct from PD-L1 in primary mediastinal large B-cell lymphoma, refining biomarkers for PD-1 blockade in a lymphoma driven by 9p24.1 alterations.

items.title: Minor histocompatibility antigen-directed TCR-engineered T-cell therapy after allogeneic transplantation
items.abstract: Review of minor histocompatibility antigen-directed TCR-engineered T-cell therapy (MiHA TCR-T), which exploits recipient-restricted polymorphic peptides to enhance graft-versus-leukemia activity after allogeneic hematopoietic cell transplantation.

items.title: Reframing leukemia-niche interactions: the emerging role of the marrow adipocyte lineage
items.abstract: Review reframing leukemia-niche interactions around the bone-marrow adipocyte lineage, highlighting how marrow fat remodeling shapes normal and malignant hematopoiesis and offers candidate microenvironmental targets.

items.title: Selective degradation of platelet BTK by PROTAC NX-5948 gives antithrombotic benefit without affecting haemostasis
items.abstract: Preclinical study showing selective degradation of platelet BTK by the PROTAC NX-5948 confers antithrombotic benefit without impairing hemostasis, pointing to a targeted-protein-degradation strategy that may decouple thrombosis protection from bleeding risk.

items.title: Internal mammary and medial supraclavicular nodal irradiation in node-negative breast cancer: 20-year EORTC 22922/10925 subset
items.abstract: Unplanned subset analysis of 20-year outcomes from the phase 3 EORTC 22922/10925 trial, examining internal mammary and medial supraclavicular nodal irradiation specifically in node-negative stage I-III breast cancer.

items.title: Signaling mutations negate the favorable impact of NPM1 mutations in older AML treated with venetoclax/HMA
items.abstract: Among older NPM1-mutated AML patients treated with venetoclax plus a hypomethylating agent, co-occurring signaling-pathway mutations (e.g., FLT3, RAS) abrogated the favorable prognosis NPM1 usually confers, refining risk stratification in the lower-intensity era.

items.title: Long-term follow-up of oral decitabine/cedazuridine plus venetoclax in older or unfit newly diagnosed AML
items.abstract: Extended follow-up of a phase II study of a fully oral decitabine/cedazuridine plus venetoclax regimen in older or unfit newly diagnosed AML, reporting durable remissions with an all-oral, chemotherapy-free option.

items.title: PRISM risk model: prognostication after hypomethylating agents plus venetoclax in AML
items.abstract: Using a multinational dataset of 2,092 patients, the authors developed and validated the PRISM prognostic model integrating clinical, cytogenetic and molecular features to risk-stratify AML treated with lower-intensity venetoclax-based therapy.

items.title: Vibecotamab (CD123 bispecific) for MRD-positive AML and for MDS/CMML after hypomethylating-agent failure: phase II
items.abstract: Phase II study of the CD123xCD3 T-cell engager vibecotamab in measurable residual disease-positive AML and in relapsed/refractory MDS and chronic myelomonocytic leukemia after HMA failure - low-blast myeloid diseases with few options.

items.title: Single-cell DNA methylation analysis uncovers epigenetic pathways in MDS-to-AML transformation
items.abstract: Single-cell DNA-methylation profiling maps epigenetic pathways underlying transformation of myelodysplastic syndrome to acute myeloid leukemia, nominating methylation programs that accompany progression.

items.title: Fibrocytes drive JAK2V617F-mutated myelofibrosis; pitavastatin reverses marrow fibrosis and anemia
items.abstract: In JAK2V617F myelofibrosis models, bone-marrow fibrocytes (not only neoplastic megakaryocytes) drove fibrosis, and the statin pitavastatin reversed marrow fibrosis and anemia - a potentially repurposable anti-fibrotic strategy.

items.title: A potent and manipulable graft-versus-leukemia effect underpins the role of transplantation in AML
items.abstract: Review arguing that a manipulable graft-versus-leukemia effect underpins the increasingly important role of allogeneic transplantation in AML, and how it can be harnessed with modern strategies.

items.title: A dose-dense CD19 CAR T-cell strategy yields durable responses without added toxicity in B-cell NHL
items.abstract: Because CD19 CAR T-cell therapy achieves durable remission in only 30-40% of relapsed/refractory B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma, the authors tested a novel dose-dense administration strategy and observed durable responses without increased toxicity.

items.title: Female sex is associated with superior outcomes after CD19 CAR T-cell therapy for large B-cell lymphoma
items.abstract: Cohort analysis of CD19-directed CAR T-cell therapy for large B-cell lymphoma found female sex independently associated with superior outcomes, a sex-based disparity warranting mechanistic study.

items.title: Anti-CD47 antibody magrolimab plus pembrolizumab in relapsed/refractory classic Hodgkin lymphoma
items.abstract: Early-phase study combining the anti-CD47 macrophage-checkpoint antibody magrolimab with the PD-1 inhibitor pembrolizumab in relapsed/refractory classic Hodgkin lymphoma.

items.title: Sonrotoclax (BGB-11417), a next-generation BCL2 inhibitor, in mantle cell lymphoma after anti-CD20 and BTK inhibitor
items.abstract: Phase I/II study of sonrotoclax, a more selective and potent BCL2 inhibitor than venetoclax, as monotherapy in mantle cell lymphoma previously treated with anti-CD20 therapy and a BTK inhibitor.

items.title: Validation of the refined Deauville 5a score in advanced-stage classic Hodgkin lymphoma
items.abstract: Validation of the Lugano-refined Deauville score, which subdivides DS5 into 5a (high uptake, no new lesions) and 5b (new lesions), showing improved prognostic discrimination on interim PET in advanced classic Hodgkin lymphoma.

items.title: A single-cell atlas identifies oncogenic transcriptional programs and immune-escape mechanisms in CTCL
items.abstract: Single-cell atlas of primary cutaneous T-cell lymphoma delineates oncogenic transcriptional programs and immune-escape mechanisms in advanced-stage disease, nominating candidate therapeutic vulnerabilities.

items.title: Real-world outcomes with BCMA- and GPRC5D-targeting bispecific antibodies in plasma cell leukemia
items.abstract: Multicenter retrospective study of 122 patients with primary or secondary plasma cell leukemia - a group excluded from pivotal trials - evaluating real-world outcomes with BCMA- and GPRC5D-directed T-cell-redirecting bispecific antibodies.

items.title: Impact of disease biology and bridging strategy on BCMA CAR T-cell outcomes in relapsed/refractory myeloma
items.abstract: Analysis of how disease biology and choice of bridging therapy during the manufacturing window affect outcomes after BCMA-directed CAR T-cell therapy in relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma.

items.title: Emapalumab and eltrombopag rescue for prolonged IEC-HS after myeloma CAR T-cell therapy
items.abstract: Case series describing rescue with the IFN-gamma antibody emapalumab plus eltrombopag for prolonged immune effector cell-associated hemophagocytic-like syndrome (IEC-HS) after CAR T-cell therapy in multiple myeloma.

items.title: Response kinetics as a dynamic prognostic marker in multiple myeloma
items.abstract: Report proposing depth and speed of response kinetics as a dynamic, longitudinal prognostic marker in multiple myeloma, complementing static baseline risk factors.

items.title: Prognostic implications of autoimmune hemolytic anemia in CLL across treatment eras
items.abstract: Study of the clinical and molecular features and prognostic significance of autoimmune hemolytic anemia, which affects 5-10% of chronic lymphocytic leukemia patients, across chemoimmunotherapy and targeted-therapy eras.

items.title: Philadelphia-positive T-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia: a Mayo Clinic series
items.abstract: Single-center case series characterizing the rare entity of Philadelphia-chromosome-positive T-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia, its features and outcomes.

items.title: FATP2-mediated lipid metabolism drives CAR T-cell resistance in B-cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia
items.abstract: Preclinical work identifying FATP2-mediated lipid metabolism as a driver of resistance to CD19 CAR T-cell therapy in B-cell ALL, suggesting a metabolic target to improve durable response.

items.title: A holistic prognostic model for leukemia-free survival after allogeneic transplantation in acute leukemia
items.abstract: Development of an integrated prognostic model predicting leukemia-free survival after allogeneic hematopoietic cell transplantation in acute leukemia, moving beyond single-domain scores toward the outcome that best reflects transplant success.

items.title: Early software-assisted response predicts survival in newly diagnosed chronic GVHD: a prospective cohort
items.abstract: Prospective multicenter study of 258 newly diagnosed chronic GVHD patients showing that early, software-assisted response assessment predicts failure-free and overall survival after best available therapy.

items.title: Real-world maribavir for refractory CMV after allogeneic hematopoietic cell transplantation
items.abstract: Real-world evaluation of maribavir efficacy and safety for refractory or resistant cytomegalovirus infection, and in patients intolerant of conventional anti-CMV agents, after allogeneic hematopoietic cell transplantation.

items.title: Apixaban for treatment of venous thromboembolism in pediatric patients: an open-label randomized trial
items.abstract: Open-label multicenter randomized controlled trial evaluating the safety and efficacy of the direct oral anticoagulant apixaban for venous thromboembolism in children, a population with few evidence-based DOAC guidelines.

items.title: Incidence and predictors of recurrent VTE after isolated distal DVT: RIDTS trial post-hoc analysis
items.abstract: Post-hoc analysis of the randomized RIDTS trial characterizing the incidence and predictors of recurrent venous thromboembolism after anticoagulation for isolated distal deep vein thrombosis.

items.title: Extended half-life clotting factors increase gene therapy efficacy in hemophilia B
items.abstract: Preclinical study showing that using extended half-life clotting-factor transgenes improves the efficacy of hemophilia B gene therapy, addressing the substantial interpatient variability seen in clinical trials.

items.title: Trastuzumab rezetecan versus pyrotinib plus capecitabine in HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer (HORIZON-Breast01)
items.abstract: Interim analysis of the phase 3 HORIZON-Breast01 trial comparing the HER2 antibody-drug conjugate trastuzumab rezetecan against pyrotinib plus capecitabine in HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer after trastuzumab and chemotherapy.

items.title: Zenocutuzumab in NRG1 fusion-positive advanced cholangiocarcinoma: the eNRGy phase II trial
items.abstract: Phase II eNRGy results for the HER2xHER3 bispecific antibody zenocutuzumab in NRG1 gene fusion-positive cholangiocarcinoma, a setting with no approved targeted therapies.

items.title: Dose escalation with intraoperative radiotherapy in newly diagnosed glioblastoma (INTRAGO-II): phase 3
items.abstract: Open-label multicenter phase 3 INTRAGO-II trial evaluating whether adding intraoperative radiotherapy to standard chemoradiotherapy improves outcomes in newly diagnosed glioblastoma, where most tumors recur locally.

items.title: SBRT plus abiraterone and ADT in oligometastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer (ARTO): long-term overall survival
items.abstract: Long-term, unplanned overall-survival analysis of the randomized phase 2 ARTO trial adding stereotactic body radiotherapy to abiraterone acetate and androgen-deprivation therapy in oligometastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer.

items.title: Novel strategies to overcome the blood-brain barrier in triple-negative breast cancer brain metastases
items.abstract: Review of emerging strategies to breach the blood-brain barrier for treating triple-negative breast cancer brain metastases, the most aggressive subtype with limited options and poor prognosis.

items.title: A dual-modular-nanobody CAR-T platform against the solid-tumor microenvironment
items.abstract: Preclinical CAR T-cell platform using dual modular nanobodies to localize CTLA-4 blockade and overcome antigen heterogeneity and the immunosuppressive microenvironment of solid tumors, aiming to limit systemic checkpoint toxicity.

items.title: Large language model-guided CAR-T in silico platform for cytokine optimization in low-antigen liver cancer
items.abstract: Proof-of-concept using a large language model-guided in silico platform to optimize cytokine engineering for CAR T-cells targeting liver cancer with low antigen density and an immunosuppressive microenvironment.

items.title: Teclistamab-based induction in transplant-eligible, newly diagnosed multiple myeloma: a phase 2 trial
items.abstract: Phase 2 trial of induction with the BCMAxCD3 bispecific antibody teclistamab plus daratumumab in transplant-eligible newly diagnosed multiple myeloma, moving T-cell-redirecting immunotherapy into the frontline setting.

items.title: Single-cell spatial transcriptomics trace the DCIS-to-invasive breast carcinoma transition
items.abstract: Integrating single-cell RNA sequencing, spatial transcriptomics and genomics across 28 patients, the study shows invasion is driven mainly by clonal expansion of pre-existing DCIS subclones with transcriptional reprogramming and microenvironment remodeling, defining stages of basement-membrane breach linked to survival.

items.title: Improving neoadjuvant and perioperative therapy in non-small-cell lung cancer
items.abstract: Review synthesizing evidence for pathological complete response as a surrogate for durable benefit in resectable NSCLC and how ctDNA, radiomics and immune biomarkers can guide escalation or de-escalation of perioperative chemoimmunotherapy.
